svg.title: Umbra Unit Frames — the options window
svg.text: What /uuf already sets, in one small window: Soundstone's shape — a title, sections, switches, two
actions and a quiet footer — in Umbra's own colors. Every control takes effect where you stand, without a
reload, as the command does today.
accent edge where a frame has its class edge
the chosen side carries a 2 px line
the same on all five clients
while the frames can be dragged
Two states it has to show
The mover is refused, as /uuf unlock refuses it. The
layout stays live: one picked now is applied when the
The party column steps back on that client, so the
